enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the adapter is enabled in configuration

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: Whether all required settings are configured

health.title: Health
health.description: Current health status (healthy, unhealthy, disabled, not_configured)

role.title: Role
role.description: Role assigned to this API key (e.g. ADMIN, OPERATOR, AUDIT_OBSERVER)

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Optional tenant/workspace owner for this API key

expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days
expires_in_days.description: Optional lifetime of the key in days

quota_daily.title: Quota Daily
quota_daily.description: Daily usage quota (None/null = unlimited, 0 = blocked, >0 = limit)

quota_monthly.title: Quota Monthly
quota_monthly.description: Monthly usage quota (None/null = unlimited, 0 = blocked, >0 = limit)

plaintext_key.title: Plaintext Key
plaintext_key.description: Plaintext API key. Only returned once upon creation.

quota_daily.title: Quota Daily
quota_daily.description: Daily quota limit. Set to None/null for unlimited, 0 to block, >0 for active limit.

quota_monthly.title: Quota Monthly
quota_monthly.description: Monthly quota limit. Set to None/null for unlimited, 0 to block, >0 for active limit.

incident_id.title: Incident Id
incident_id.description: ID of the incident to evaluate

action_type.title: Action Type
action_type.description: Proposed action type to evaluate eligibility for

decision_id.title: Decision Id
decision_id.description: Unique ID of the decision log

risk_level.title: Risk Level
risk_level.description: Computed risk level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

active_autonomy_mode.title: Active Autonomy Mode
active_autonomy_mode.description: Active autonomy mode setting at calculation time

requires_human_gate.title: Requires Human Gate
requires_human_gate.description: Whether a human gate validation is required

human_gate_type.title: Human Gate Type
human_gate_type.description: Type of human gate required (e.g. remediation_approval)

decision_reason.title: Decision Reason
decision_reason.description: Detailed explanation of the decision logic

source.title: Source
source.description: Source of the skill, e.g. external-vendor or bilgeapi-custom

risk_level.title: Risk Level
risk_level.description: Risk level, e.g. low, medium, high_value_policy

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the skill markdown file

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed description parsed from the markdown file

category.title: Category
category.description: Category of the skill, e.g. Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, Ship

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
webhook_url.description: Target URL for testing webhook dispatch

status.title: Status
status.description: Workflow delivery outcome (SENT, FAILED, or DEAD_LETTER)

resolved_ip.title: Resolved Ip
resolved_ip.description: The resolved target server IP address
